pinion has 12 teeth, below the undercut limit of 17.1 for a 20.0 degree transverse pressure angle at x=0; a real cutter would undercut the flank near the root, and the selected rack-generated root shows that form limit
the spiral angle runs 11.3 deg at the toe to 9.4 at the heel, a 20.7 deg swing; a cutter larger than the 40.09 mm one would flatten it
high spiral angle increases axial thrust
